rules.text: the diminutive infix ي is a literal template letter, never a radical; a plain sound triliteral surfaces as فُعَيْل
shape alone never certifies identity or meaning: a diminutive match ALSO requires attested base-lexeme evidence and a licensed affix-marker declaration bound to this template's own infix letter

a hollow (medial-weak) base restores its weak radical literally in the diminutive template; that literal realization must be explicitly licensed per template and slot, exactly like every other template_classification pack -- an uncontracted or unlicensed weak shape is never assumed regular
this pack authors ONLY the plain triliteral fُعَيْل family (L6.M5.01); it makes no claim about quadriliteral-base diminutives
